scope.holdout_usage: final scoring only; never used for training, calibration or feature statistics
scope.kind: V3.1 genuine retraining with probability calibration
scope.median_impute_source: discovery split medians plus explicit missingness flags
scope.roi_definition: one unit per bet at decimal odds when probability >= 0.55; Asian half win/loss and push settled exactly
scope.target_definition: per fixture and market, the T-5 maximum-EV Crown lead (the 'big' side the model backs); label 1 for a full win, 0.5 for a half win, 0 for a half or full loss, pushes excluded
scope.v2_baseline_definition: persisted production V2 probability (70% market + 30% team history) on the same rows

split.method: chronological kickoff cohorts nearest to 60/20/20; equal kickoff is indivisible
